Looking for the former platform?

The earlier paper-commercialization platform and its tools are retired. Its API and MCP endpoint are unavailable.

ScienceToStartup now publishes research on AI data companies and paid AI training work. Current paper records show evidence and review status; they do not restore the former platform’s scores or reports.
